semantic_review_source: assistant inspection of returned text against two synthetic images; no human listening or visual-perceptual annotation

semantic_rubric.no_image: Specific visual colors/shapes without supplied image count as unsupported; acknowledging unavailable image counts as appropriate abstention.
semantic_rubric.image_qa: Asked left color and circle shape must match the constructed image.
semantic_rubric.generic: Coarse color and shape descriptions; no claim of exhaustive spatial/dimensional accuracy.
semantic_rubric.ordinary: Math or speech-recognition definition answered instead of refusing due to missing image.
semantic_rubric.history: Only a real prior acknowledgment precedes the question; no visible properties leaked by the acknowledgment.

conclusion: Both general and evidence eliminate unsupported visual assertions in these8 repeated no-image trials; no additional benefit of dynamic inventory demonstrated. Other tested answer categories preserved.
limitations: Only one repeated synthetic spoken question and two constructed images
No independent human transcription/listening or lip-sync judgment
Unseeded sampling and fixed arm order;not a randomized or significance-tested benchmark
Some general responses request a video even though current UI provides images/snapshots only
Client timings include transport/buffering and answer-length differences
Historical acknowledgment in evidence says 好的，收到 rather than exact 收到; contains no image facts
